title: observability: token-level KV cache hit-rate + cost/latency breakdowns; dashboards & alert tuning
author: Rohan Patel
description:
Motivation: we need finer-grained visibility into KV cache behavior and per-token cost/latency so platform SLOs and customer billing signals are actionable. This PR adds a token-level KV cache hit-rate metric, surfaces KV-related traces, updates Grafana dashboards with cost/latency breakdowns at token granularity, and tunes alerts to reduce noise while preserving critical signal.

Summary of changes: added a new metric (redwood.kv.cache.token_hit_rate) emitted per-request with labels (model, deployment, region, cache_shard). Instrumented the KV cache path to emit structured tracing spans (kv.lookup, kv.miss_penalty) and included span attributes for sequence_length and token_count. Dashboard updates include a dedicated "KV cache health" row with hit-rate, miss latency, and cost-per-token panels; an updated "Token economics" dashboard that breaks cost & latency down by prefix vs. decode tokens; and new alert rules that combine absolute thresholds with rate-of-change to avoid flapping.

Checklist: - [x] Metric emitted from runtime with tags and cardinality controls - [x] Tracing spans added and linked to existing request trace - [x] Grafana dashboards updated (templates + panels) - [x] Alert rules added and tested in staging - [x] Unit + integration tests for metric emission - [x] Documentation + changelog entry

Testing & rollout: unit tests added to runtime metrics module and e2e smoke that asserts KV hit-rate increases with synthetic warm prefixes. Deployed to staging via canary (10% traffic) for 48h; observed stable hit-rate and no alert noise. After a brief follow-up fix to label cardinality (reduced high-card label), the change was promoted to 100% in prod. CI initially failed on lint (unused import) and a flaky test; both were addressed in follow-up commits and CI passed on re-run.

Notes: kept label cardinality low by bounding cache_shard and normalizing model names. Alerts tuned to combine token-level p95 miss latency > 40ms AND sustained increase in miss-rate over 5m. This should reduce false positives for transient traffic spikes. Related work: ENG-1843 (kv-cache instrumentation), ENG-1978 (dashboard refactor).

feat(obs): add kv lookup tracing spans with attributes
chore(dashboards): update grafana token-economics and kv-health dashboards
fix(tests): address flaky metrics test + lint

release_notes: Added token-level KV cache hit-rate and KV tracing spans. New dashboards for token-level cost/latency and tuned alerts to reduce noise. No breaking changes.
